# v0.8

Released 2026-11-03. The first tagged release.

## Highlights

- First packaged version of the unofficial Zwift snap: installs Zwift on first run through
  the graphical installer and launches it with Wine.
- Yad-based progress dialogs, audio routed to the host over PulseAudio, and the workshop
  definition used to build it.

## Commits

- Fix yad icons: build gdk-pixbuf loader cache and mime cache (0.8) (85f796e)
- Add yad, remove zwift.update, silent installer and version fix (0.5) (d3ce526)
- Single zwift command: install or update with yad progress dialog, add launcher tests (4a0d8a6)
- Install Zwift on first run, drop zwift.install and corefonts (0.3) (6a7f44c)
- Fix libpulsecommon lookup for audio, prune unneeded files (0.2) (92e8ab9)
- Use audio-playback only: point libpulse at the host socket (55e7960)
- Use the graphical Zwift installer (a5575a5)
- Ship xkb-data and fix alsa config paths (da0e8f0)
- Fix runfromprocess build deps, drop verbosity flag, add README (40a6dd0)
- Add zwift snap, launcher scripts and workshop actions (00198ff)
- Add workshop definition and gitignore (4557b4f)
